4120f8b5-9bd2-4537-8583-f259f1296556.name: PCA - Availability - Ping Instance - Reachability SLI (%)
4120f8b5-9bd2-4537-8583-f259f1296556.description: OBJECT: ping adapter instance. UNIT: percent. Reachable over total child checks: the L1 instantaneous SLI; its window average is the L1 attainment budget.py reports. PCA Availability arm, L1 SLI set; companion artifacts at privatecloudarchitect.com/handbook/availability.

36ae2a5e-e941-471c-b763-53d39c144879.name: PCA - Availability - Ping Instance - Checks (count)
36ae2a5e-e941-471c-b763-53d39c144879.formula: (count(${adaptertype=PingAdapter, objecttype=fqdn_type, metric=peak_packet_loss, depth=1}) + count(${adaptertype=PingAdapter, objecttype=ip_type, metric=peak_packet_loss, depth=1}))
36ae2a5e-e941-471c-b763-53d39c144879.description: OBJECT: ping adapter instance. UNIT: count. Independent monitored endpoints (direct child checks of both kinds; an IP that a declared FQDN resolves to folds under the FQDN and counts once). PCA Availability arm, L1 SLI set; companion artifacts at privatecloudarchitect.com/handbook/availability.

56dadd97-427f-4728-9abd-c6621846c3c2.name: PCA - Availability - Ping Instance - Checks Reachable (count)
56dadd97-427f-4728-9abd-c6621846c3c2.formula: (count(${adaptertype=PingAdapter, objecttype=fqdn_type, metric=peak_packet_loss, depth=1, where=($value < 100)}) + count(${adaptertype=PingAdapter, objecttype=ip_type, metric=peak_packet_loss, depth=1, where=($value < 100)}))
56dadd97-427f-4728-9abd-c6621846c3c2.description: OBJECT: ping adapter instance. UNIT: count. Child checks whose worst-of-cycle loss stayed under 100 percent (some reply arrived). PCA Availability arm, L1 SLI set; companion artifacts at privatecloudarchitect.com/handbook/availability.

c452ab2e-85f6-4abd-9a88-fdd20ad6e8da.name: PCA - Availability - Check - Packet Delivery (%)
c452ab2e-85f6-4abd-9a88-fdd20ad6e8da.description: OBJECT: ping check (ip_type/fqdn_type). UNIT: percent. 100 minus the cycle's WORST packet loss (peak_packet_loss, the non-instanced key): the conservative per-check delivery figure. PCA Availability arm, L1 SLI set; companion artifacts at privatecloudarchitect.com/handbook/availability.

c48eb8af-c73d-4126-916a-725c86ed00d0.name: PCA - Availability - Ping Instance - Checks Unreachable (count)
c48eb8af-c73d-4126-916a-725c86ed00d0.description: OBJECT: ping adapter instance. UNIT: count. Checks minus reachable (same-object composition). PCA Availability arm, L1 SLI set; companion artifacts at privatecloudarchitect.com/handbook/availability.
